Emergent Industrial Solutions Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 12/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve This is to inform you that a meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company will be held on Thursday, 12th November, 2026, inter-alia, to consider and approve the following agenda: - 
1. Standalone and Consolidated Un-audited Financial Statements of the company for the quarter ended on September 30, 2026. - 
2. To transact any other business with the permission of the chair. 
Pursuant to Company's code of conduct for prevention of Insider Trading to regulate, monitor and report trading by Designated persons, the trading window shall remain closed for all the Designated Persons from 1st October, 2026 upto 48 hours after the audited financial results of the Company for the quarter ended on 30.9.2026 are declared to the stock exchanges.
